## Decisions (section 4)
| PLC program generation | Owner asked 2026-10-31: "How PLC program will be changed as per PLC or process selection? Can it be developed by vision core software automatically as per need?" and approved the proposal ("Yes, as proposed"): Vision Core generates the program source at the first installation from tested templates only, one per PLC family; an engineer compiles, downloads and tests it in the maker's tool (IQ/OQ); the software never downloads or changes the program by itself, never on a running line; process changes are line settings written to the PLC, not new programs; the layout version check refuses a mismatched program. | 11 (HW-05 to HW-08), 15 |
